password_help: 8–128 characters. Use a password unique to this application.
username_help: 3–32 letters, digits, periods, hyphens or underscores.
welcome_body: Focused practice, realistic timed sessions and explanations that help you understand every choice.
local_note: Your profiles and results stay on this computer. Keep the server running to practice from your phone.
session_idle_notice: For your security, you will be signed out after one hour without interaction. Saved practice progress is kept.
session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue. Saved answers are kept and practice timers keep running.
registration_closed: New profiles are disabled on this server.
practice_subtitle: Choose a bank. Every certification keeps its own progress and question cycle.
no_matching_banks: No banks match this search. Try another name or code.
one_active: Finish or submit your current session before starting another certification.
average_detail: Average of {count} completed quizzes in this bank.
no_average: Complete a quiz to see your average.
no_banks: No question banks are available yet.
no_banks_help: An administrator can import a bank from the Administration page.
score_notice: Practice scores are percentages, not official AWS scaled scores. Meeting a practice target does not guarantee certification.
original_notice: Independent practice material. Not an official AWS exam or a source of leaked questions.
bank_language_fallback: This bank does not include your UI language. Questions are shown in {language}.
save_failed: Last change not confirmed. Check the selected answer and try again.
network_error: The server could not be reached. Recent changes may not have been saved; the timer keeps running.
map_legend: Filled: answered · Ring: current · Star: review
submit_body: {answered} of {total} questions are fully answered. Unanswered or incomplete selections receive no credit. Submission cannot be undone.
distribution_note: Domain proportions were adjusted to avoid repeating unseen-cycle questions. The report shows the actual distribution.
history_subtitle: Review quizzes and exams across certifications, including older bank versions.
no_history: Your completed sessions will appear here.
profile_subtitle: Your history is separate from other learners. Sign in with this profile on any device on your LAN.
password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
export_note: A personal JSON export, without passwords or other users' results. For review, not automatic restoration.
admin_default_warning: You are using the initial administrator password. Change it in Profile before sharing access to the server.
admin_subtitle: Import versioned content and configure practice formats without editing the application.
zip_help: ZIP up to 10 MiB, containing only manifest.json and questions.json at the root.
replace_warning: This replaces version {version}. New sessions use the new defaults and a fresh question cycle. Existing sessions and history remain unchanged.
confirm_replace: I understand and authorize this bank update.
schema_help: Includes JSON Schemas, an importable bilingual example, a validator and authoring instructions for humans and AI agents.
proportional: Calculate quiz time proportionally to the exam
format_help: Time is expressed in seconds: 90 minutes = 5400. Unscored questions are hidden until submission.
weights_help: Must total 100. No-repeat cycles take priority when exact proportions are not possible.
settings_effect: Saved settings affect new sessions only. Active sessions keep their original settings.
validate_first: Select a ZIP and validate it before importing.
version_exists: This bank ID and version already exist. Use a new version number for an update.
replacement_confirmation_required: Confirm the replacement before importing a new version of this bank.
invalid_username: Use 3–32 letters, digits, periods, hyphens or underscores for the username.
invalid_password: Passwords must contain 8–128 characters when created or changed.
invalid_display_name: The display name must contain 1–64 valid characters.
username_exists: That username is already in use.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
profile_changed: The active profile changed in another tab. Sign in again to continue safely.
admin_required: This action requires the administrator profile.
active_attempt_exists: You already have an active session. Continue or submit it first.
attempt_not_found: This session does not exist or does not belong to your profile.
attempt_not_finished: Submit the session before exporting its results.
revision_conflict: Another tab or device changed this session. The saved state has been reloaded.
invalid_selection: The selected options are not valid for this question.
host_forbidden: Open the local address shown by the server.
origin_forbidden: Requests must come from this local application.
invalid_content_type: The request uses an unsupported content type.
request_too_large: The upload is empty or too large.
invalid_json: A valid JSON object is required.
not_found: The requested resource does not exist.
internal_error: The server could not complete the operation. Check its terminal before trying again.
rule_invalid_text: A nonempty text within the length limit is required.
rule_integer_out_of_range: An integer within the allowed range is required.
rule_invalid_languages: Declare en, es, or both without duplicates.
rule_invalid_language: The default language must be declared.
rule_invalid_date: Use a valid ISO date: YYYY-MM-DD.
rule_invalid_url: Use a valid HTTPS reference URL.
rule_unknown_domain: The question refers to an undeclared domain.
rule_duplicate_prompt: Question prompts must not be duplicated.
rule_boolean_required: Use a JSON boolean: true or false.
rule_duplicate_option: Options in the same question must not repeat.
rule_unknown_reference: Every reference ID must be declared.
rule_empty_domain: Every declared domain needs at least one question.
rule_archive_size: The ZIP must be nonempty and at most 10 MiB.
rule_exactly_two_json_files: ZIP root must contain only manifest.json and questions.json.
rule_encrypted_zip: Encrypted ZIP files are not accepted.
rule_compression_ratio: The compression ratio exceeds the safety limit.
rule_invalid_zip_or_json: The ZIP or JSON content could not be read safely.
rush_rules_short: One mistake starts a new set. The clock never resets.
rush_admin_help: One global time limit, including feedback and restarts. All generated questions count toward the score denominator.
rush_failed_body: Read the correction below. Set {round}, with {goal} new questions, is already generated and counted in your score.
rush_option_analysis: Your answer and explanation of every option
rush_clock_running: The timer is still running while you read this feedback.
rush_confirmation_hint: Select all required options, then confirm. Confirmed answers cannot be changed. Saving a selection alone does not score it.
rush_rules: Confirm {goal} correct answers in a row before time runs out to finish. A wrong answer shows the correction and generates a new full set. Your streak resets, but your time and accumulated correct answers do not.
rush_score_notice: Score = 100 × confirmed correct answers ÷ ALL generated questions. Unanswered and discarded questions count in the denominator. Completing the streak and achieving a high percentage are different goals.
rush_cycle_notice: RUSH shares the question pool with quizzes and exams. A generated set is consumed in full, even when discarded after a mistake. Questions repeat only after the pool is exhausted; never within one set.
rush_end_body: Confirmed answers will be scored against every generated question. Any draft selection will not count. The session cannot be resumed once ended.
rush_current_only: Only the current RUSH question can be answered. The session has been synchronized.
rush_no_flags: RUSH does not allow flagging or skipping questions.
rush_complete_selection: Select exactly the required number of answers before confirming.
rush_feedback_pending: Read the feedback and continue before answering the next question.
rush_no_feedback: There is no pending feedback. The session has been synchronized.
rule_rush_requires_schema_2: The rush defaults field requires schema_version 2.
